C1852.title: ICO Reprimanded Sky Betting for Sharing Advertising Cookie Data Without Consent
keywords: ICO Reprimanded Sky Betting for Sharing Advertising Cookie Data Without Consent
C1852.summary: In September 2024, the UK Information Commissioner's Office issued a reprimand to Bonne Terre Limited, trading as Sky Betting and Gaming. The ICO investigation found that from January to March 2023, when users accessed the SkyBet website, personal information was processed and shared with advertising technology companies before users had the opportunity to accept or reject advertising cookies, enabling personalised advertising purposes.

references.title: Action taken against Sky Betting and Gaming for using cookies without consent - ICO
